result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: a stray horizontal line in the bottom navigation bar that overlaps icons.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar contains a stray horizontal gray line that runs from the search icon across to the adjacent icon, overlapping both and looking like a misplaced active-tab indicator or rendering artifact.
issues.suggestion: Remove the stray stroke, or reposition the active-tab indicator so it sits cleanly beneath the selected Home tab without crossing the other navigation icons.
